entities.name: Riptide Island
entities.description: A hidden island off the southeastern coast of Otaria, site of the Riptide Project.

entities.name: Riptide Project
entities.description: A secret research collaboration of cephalid and Otarian wizards that recreated slivers.

entities.name: Empress Llawan
entities.description: Ruler of the cephalid empire who founded the Riptide Project to end prejudice against air-breathers.

entities.name: Slivers
entities.description: Creatures revived by the Project that escaped control and swarmed the island.

entities.name: Pemmin
entities.description: A researcher who survived and fled the island.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: The power from which the Riptide Project hid its existence.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: Event after which the island was populated.

events.summary: Empress Llawan allies her best sorcerers with Otarian wizards, creating the Riptide Project on the island.
events.quote: she established an alliance between her best sorcerers and some powerful Otarian wizards

events.summary: The Project's wizards revive a dead sliver and breed new types with new powers.
events.quote: the Project’s wizards revived it, breeding new types with new powers

events.summary: The slivers, with no queen to control them, swarm Riptide Island and kill most of the researchers; survivors such as Pemmin flee.
events.quote: the slivers eventually swarmed all over Riptide Island, killing most of the researchers

events.summary: A sliver in the form of a junior researcher slips out of Riptide and the slivers spread across mainland Otaria.
events.quote: Taking the form of a junior researcher, the first sliver slipped out of Riptide.

relations.note: She established the alliance behind it.
relations.quote: she established an alliance between her best sorcerers and some powerful Otarian wizards
